description: Copies a user-selected ChatGPT video attachment up to 128 MiB to the connected DubSync account for media preparation. Ask permission to upload this specific video first. Supports known-length downloads from OpenAI-owned oaiusercontent.com hosts; unsupported or expired links require a fresh supported file or direct HTTP upload. Does not start translation or authorize AI processing.

download_url.description: The temporary download URL supplied by ChatGPT; never an arbitrary website URL.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable unique key for this operation. Reuse it with the exact same input after a timeout; never generate a new key to retry.

uploadConfirmed.description: True only after the user authorizes copying this specific file into their DubSync account. This is not translation consent.

name: dub_import_file

data.description: The safe public API response, or resumable-upload status.

title: Import a ChatGPT video file
